title: Layout
description: corner stack = a compact column with a large combo and the progress ring beside it. horizontal = one strip (combo, accuracy, score, HP, progress) for the top or bottom edge.

title: Position
description: Screen edge or corner the HUD sits in. The connection chip appears in the same place.

title: Edge inset / px
description: Distance from the screen edges at 1920×1080; clamped to 0–480.

title: Size
description: Scale factor for the whole HUD; clamped to 0.5–3.

title: Score separators
description: Thousands separator for the score, e.g. 01,234,567 / 01.234.567 / 01 234 567. Leading zeros are dimmed.

title: Show combo
description: Large combo with a bump on every hit and a red break flash when the combo is lost. The rail under it shows combo against the map's max combo; the tick marks the peak this play.

title: Show rank letter
description: Small grade next to the accuracy. Silver (Hidden/Flashlight) grades use a filled chip.

title: Show HP
description: Health bar from /play/healthBar/normal (0–200), shown as a percentage. Turns red under 25%; results hold the last gameplay value.

title: Show progress ring
description: Map progress from first to last object, with the remaining time adjusted for rate mods.
